kinds.name: task
kinds.description: What the conversation is working on: the goal the person set, in one sentence.

kinds.name: decision
kinds.description: A choice the person settled, such as a library, an approach, or a name; name it by what was decided.

kinds.name: preference
kinds.description: How someone likes things done, such as a reviewer's or the person's style; name it by whose and what.

kinds.name: entity
kinds.description: A named thing and what it is called or numbered: a codename, a ticket, a person, a project.

kinds.name: tests
kinds.description: Whether a test or build command passed or failed, named by the command or by what it covers, such as CI.

kinds.name: file
kinds.description: A file read or changed, named by its path, with what was read or written.

kinds.name: service
kinds.description: Something running on this Mac now: a server, a port in use, a process.

kinds.name: machine
kinds.description: The state of this Mac now: memory, disk space, battery, network.

kinds.name: workdir
kinds.description: The directory the work happens in.

kinds.name: branch
kinds.description: The git branch the work is on.
